description: Using the Splunk Enterprise web interface, search for failed SSH login attempts in the security_logs index. First, log in to Splunk using username 'admin' and password 'SplunkAdmin1!'. Then navigate to the Search & Reporting app, enter a search query to find events containing 'Failed' in the security_logs index (e.g., index=security_logs Failed), and run the search. The search should display results showing failed SSH authentication events. The Splunk web interface is available at http://localhost:8000.
